title: Bad Circuit Boards

lines.en: Hi Grace. We have a problem with the last order.
lines.zh: 嗨 Grace，上一批訂單出了問題。

lines.en: I'm sorry to hear that. What happened?
lines.zh: 很抱歉聽到這個消息。發生什麼事了？

lines.en: About five percent of the boards don't work.
lines.zh: 大約百分之五的電路板不能用。

lines.en: I see. We'll look into it today.
lines.zh: 了解。我們今天就會調查。

lines.en: Our line stopped for half a day because of this.
lines.zh: 我們的產線因為這樣停了半天。

lines.en: I apologize. We need to find the root cause first.
lines.zh: 真的很抱歉。我們要先找出根本原因。

lines.en: And what about the bad boards?
lines.zh: 那些壞掉的板子怎麼辦？

lines.en: We'll send a replacement for every bad board, free.
lines.zh: 每一片壞板我們都會免費換新的。

lines.en: In five days. Each board will pass a full inspection.
lines.zh: 五天內。每片板子都會通過完整檢驗。

lines.en: Five days is a bit long.
Let me ask the factory. I'll get back to you this afternoon.
lines.zh: 我問一下工廠，今天下午回覆你。

lines.en: Thanks, Grace. I'll wait for your call.

quiz.q: What is the problem with the circuit boards?
options: Some of them do not work.
quiz.why: Daniel 說大約百分之五的板子不能用。

quiz.q: What will Grace's company send for free?
quiz.why: We'll send a replacement for every bad board at no cost.

quiz.q: When will Grace call Daniel back?
quiz.why: Grace 說會先問工廠，今天下午回覆他。

words.ex1: I see. We'll look into it today.
words.ex2: The QA team will look into the customer complaint today.
words.ex2zh: 品保團隊今天會調查這個客訴。

words.pic: a tree with a red warning mark on its roots under the ground

words.pic: a smiling woman at her desk holding a phone and returning a call to a customer, the customer on the other side also holds a phone, a big round two-way arrow between them

words.pic: a hand swapping a broken circuit board for a new shiny one

words.ex1: In five days. Each board will pass a full inspection.
words.ex2: Every shipment must pass an inspection before it leaves the factory.
words.ex2zh: 每批貨離開工廠前都必須通過檢驗。
words.hook: in（往裡面）＋spect（看，像 spectator 觀眾）＋ion：往裡面仔細看＝檢驗
words.pic: a worker in a safety helmet carefully checking a circuit board with a magnifying glass, a big green check mark floating above

part2.why: 問 Where（哪裡），要回答地點。B 重複 quality 是陷阱，C 是時間。

part2.q: How many samples did you test?
part2.why: How many 問數量，答 About twenty。A 是地點，C 用 Yes 回答不通順。

part2.q: Would you like me to call the customer?
part2.why: Would you like me to 是提供協助，答 Yes, please do 最自然。A 重複 customer、B 重複 call 都是陷阱。
part2.zh: 需要我打電話給客戶嗎？

part2.why: 問 Why 要回答原因，Because 開頭。B 是 How 的答案，C 是地點。

part2.q: Should we repair the machine or buy a new one?
part2.why: 選擇問句不能用 Yes/No 回答。A、B 重複 machine 和 repair 是陷阱，C 是合理的回應。
part2.zh: 我們該修理機器還是買新的？

scene: 客戶 Daniel 打電話來抱怨電路板有瑕疵，品保人員 Grace 負責處理。

grammar.tip: 找句子裡的時間線索：yesterday／last 用過去式；since／for＋一段時間 用現在完成式；tomorrow／next 用未來式；every day／usually 用現在式。

items.q: We _____ the defective boards to the customer last Friday.
items.why: last Friday 是過去的時間點，用過去式 sent。現在完成式不能跟明確的過去時間一起用。
items.zh: 我們上週五把瑕疵板寄給了客戶。

items.q: The QA team _____ the lab test tomorrow morning.
items.why: tomorrow morning 是未來，用 will＋原形動詞：will finish。
items.zh: 品保團隊明天早上會完成實驗室測試。

items.q: Mr. Wang _____ in the quality department for ten years.
items.why: for ten years 表示「到現在已經持續十年」，用現在完成式 has worked。
items.zh: 王先生已經在品保部門工作十年了。

items.q: Our factory usually _____ about 3,000 boards a day.
items.why: usually（通常）表示習慣、固定的事，用現在式；主詞 factory 是單數，動詞加 s：produces。
items.zh: 我們工廠通常一天生產約 3,000 片電路板。

items.q: When the customer called, Grace _____ a report.
items.why: 客戶打來的「那時候」她「正在」寫報告，用過去進行式 was writing。
items.zh: 客戶打來時，Grace 正在寫報告。
